scenarios.description: high-impact quantitative claim on a single publisher -> expand
planned dimension with no attributed fact -> expand
sufficient evidence, no important gaps -> finalize
scenarios.reason: evidence sufficient: confidence at target and planned axes covered

scenarios.description: iteration ceiling reached with gaps remaining -> finalize + limitations
scenarios.reason: hard wall: iteration/depth ceiling reached; remaining gaps recorded as limitations (1 thin dimension; 1 high-impact claim uncorroborated)
limitations: Stopped at the research depth limit with outstanding evidence gaps (1 thin dimension; 1 high-impact claim uncorroborated); they are recorded below as limitations.

thresholds.description: Regression floors for the deterministic offline adaptive-depth routing evaluator (bench/eval_depth.py). Every scenario asserts the exact routing decision and reason tokens for one adaptive-depth branch; the aggregate pass rate is held at 1.0 because the branches are deterministic and a wrong decision is always a regression. Additive only: this file does not alter any threshold in thresholds_v1.json.

thresholds.description: Regression floors for the deterministic offline contradiction resolution evaluator (bench/eval_contradictions.py). Every fixture case asserts a label; the floors are set at the post-fix measured baseline so a resolution/detection regression trips. Additive only: this file does not alter any threshold in thresholds_v1.json or thresholds_depth_v1.json.

cases.description: 429 then 200: retry succeeds, no degradation, breaker closed
repeated 429 -> fallback provider, run completes, provider-transient
provider exhaustion: explicit degraded, never weak evidence
provider OK, evidence thin: weak-evidence, not provider degradation
provider degradation + weak evidence: both represented separately

thresholds.description: Regression floors for the deterministic offline provider-failure classification evaluator (bench/eval_provider.py). Every case asserts the transient-vs-hard classification and the provider-vs-evidence reason mapping; the aggregate pass rate is held at 1.0 because the mapping is deterministic and a conflation of provider failure with weak evidence is always a regression. Additive only: this file does not alter any threshold in thresholds_v1.json, thresholds_depth_v1.json or thresholds_contradictions_v1.json.

Regression floors for the deterministic offline golden evaluator. Calibrated to the CURRENT system's measured baseline (bench/results/offline_eval_v1.json) minus a small margin, so the baseline passes with headroom while a real regression trips. Invariant metrics (citation resolution, forbidden-sources clean) are held at their measured value; noisy means get a slightly larger margin. The evaluator exits non-zero on any violation.

calibration.rule: floor = measured_actual - margin (see per-metric note in the accompanying OFFLINE_EVAL_v1.md)
calibration.margin_policy: invariants: 0.0; rates: 0.05; means: ~10-15% below actual; quality/relevance: ~8 points / 0.05
